text:
Alex (runtime): Morning — quick check-in on serving-core throughput sprint. Goal for this sprint: land continuous-batching scheduler change + improved KV eviction heuristic. Targeting canary Thursday. Who's actively owning the e2e smoke and the canary gating metrics?

Maria (kernel): I have the batching scheduler PR ready, will push latest perf fixes in a bit. Local bench shows ~8% p50 improvement and ~5% p95. PR up for initial review at https://github.com/redwood/repo/pull/4157 :eyes:

Sam SRE: Ping me when it's up. I need the exact bench command and cluster config to run the throughput sweep on staging-canary. Also share the artifact tag you want me to run.

Maria (kernel): bench command I used:```
./bench --model=redwood-v1 --seq=1024 --batching=continuous --workers=8 --tag=canary-2026-03-17
```
Using condensed input set (scale=medium). Artifact: `image:redwood/runtime:canary-2026-03-17`

Jin (infra): Heads up — infra change in deploy PR #982 introduces a kube-probe tweak that touches our warmup path. That needs to land before we flip canary traffic or we'll see coldstart-exacerbated p95 spikes. I'm owner of #982 but I'm blocked by security review until EOD. Link: https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/982

Maria (kernel): OK noted — batching PR depends on #982 for safe rollout. Also found one KV-tombstone edge case — eviction after continuous batching can briefly spike miss ratio. I'll add a small ttl guard but need infra-level metric (kv_miss_ratio) on canary.

Priya (product): Schedule note: PMs prefer Thursday PM canary so customer teams can monitor on Friday morning. If any blocker persists, we should move to next Tue.

Alex (runtime): Let's clarify ownership: Maria owns the kernel PR (code + unit tests), Jin owns infra deploy (#982), Alex (me) will own canary smoke scripts and gating dashboard. Sam will run perf sweeps and validate. Priya will coordinate release windows with PMs. If everyone agrees, I'll update the sprint ticket with owners. :thumbsup:

Sam SRE: I can run the perf sweep once PR + infra merge. Expect ~45-60m runs for both baseline and patched. Please drop the exact cluster name and credentials in the perf run doc. I'll post results in #eng-sre.

Maria (kernel): PR link again: https://github.com/redwood/repo/pull/4157 — added initial test for batching correctness. I'll push kv eviction guard in a follow-up commit referencing this PR.

Alex (runtime): Quick gating thresholds we agreed: p95 end-to-end < 80ms on short seq, p95 < 200ms on long seq; error rate < 0.5%; kv_miss_ratio delta < 3% vs baseline. Sam, confirm these are measurable from the smoke scripts.

Sam SRE: Yep, can measure those. Add `smoke/gate.json` with metrics list. Example snippet I use:```
{
  "checks": ["p95 latency","error_rate","kv_miss_ratio"]
}
```
I'll wire to the canary dashboard.

Jin (infra): Security review clears at ~1700 UTC, after that I'll merge #982 and kick a rolling deploy. I'll post the deploybot message here when done.

deploy-bot: deploy started infra/prod-canary @ 1705 UTC — rolling 3/5 nodes

bench-bot: perf run queued: tag=canary-2026-03-17, benchset=scale-medium, estimated=50m

Maria (kernel): small log I saw during local multi-worker run: ```
[WARN] kv_cache: miss_ratio=0.12, spikes on eviction window start
[INFO] batching: continuous window applied, avg_batch=6.2
```
The 12% miss ratio is in local synthetic; production baseline is ~0.09. Trying TTL guard to avoid the spike.

Alex (runtime): Maria, please add a minimal unit test for the eviction path and tag me in the PR. Also add an entry to the rollout playbook: "rollback path = flip batching mode to discrete".

Maria (kernel): Will do. Pushing unit test and eviction guard in 10-15m, will update PR.

Sam SRE: After infra merge, I'll run baseline then patched. If p95 regresses >5% or kv_miss_ratio delta >3%, hold the rollout and revert. I'll post results and recommendation.

Priya (product): Thanks all — I'll message PMs about tentative Thursday PM and mark tentative hold if blockers remain.

Alex (runtime): Summary / next steps: 1) Jin finish infra PR #982 (owner Jin) 2) Maria push eviction guard + unit test to PR #4157 (owner Maria) 3) Alex will prep smoke scripts and canary dashboard (owner Alex) 4) Sam run perf sweeps and post recommendation (owner Sam) 5) Priya coordinate PM schedule (owner Priya). I'll update the sprint ticket now.

Sam SRE: I'll need an explicit ping in this thread once both merges happen.

Maria (kernel): ping @Sam SRE when PR is merged and I'm done with follow-up commit.

Alex (runtime): Noted. Thanks team — let's keep async updates here. :rocket:
